item.title: CNC
item.description:
With our ShopSabre industrial CNC router, we can cut woods, plastics, and other materials up to 4’x8’ in size. Computer numerical control allows us to make cuts with extreme precision and reliability.

Whether its a one-off custom job, or an order of 100s of the the same part, contact us to see how our CNC team can cut your pieces quickly and accurately.

item.title: Paint
item.description:
Using Benjamin Moore’s Gennex Color Technology, we are able to do a precise scan of an existing color sample, mix our own paint with our in-house tinting machine, and produce the right amount of paint needed for your custom job.

Contact us if you have a paint job you need done professionally.

item.title: VRF
item.description: Instead of traditional HVAC systems, Eclipse focuses on VRF systems for their energy-saving potential. We have worked on these systems since 2008, when we installed a VRF system in the First National Plaza building in Cloquet. This job was part of a research project by Minnesota Power, and was one of the first installations of such a system in the state. You can read Minnesota Power’s Research Profile on this VRF system here.
